ValidationRule.description: Freight Implementation: Opportunity Product should not be modified once Opportunity is Closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
Opportunity.RecordType.DeveloperName == "Freight",
OR( ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.StageName, "Closed - Accepted"), ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.StageName, "Closed - Not Accepted") )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Product can not be modified once Opportunity is Closed.
